title: HTTP/2 and QUIC
description: Web transport, multiplexing, head-of-line blocking, and connection setup.
objectives: Explain the differences between HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, and HTTP/3.
Analyse streams, packet loss, and head-of-line blocking.
Calculate connection setup costs under stated RTT assumptions.

title: Cloud Computing
description: Service models, elasticity, availability, and resource sharing.
objectives: Distinguish IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, and cloud deployment models.
Evaluate elasticity, multitenancy, and single points of failure.
Calculate basic SLA limits, costs, and capacity during failures.

title: MPLS and VPNs
description: Label stacks, traffic engineering, and virtual private networks.
objectives: Trace push, swap, and pop operations through an MPLS network.
Choose paths that meet capacity constraints and explain local rerouting.
Distinguish L2VPN, L3VPN, and the roles of their labels.

title: Interconnection Networks
description: Topologies, flow control, capacity, and routing in interconnection networks.
objectives: Compare direct and indirect networks and their bisection bandwidth.
Calculate credit requirements, transfer time, and payload throughput.

title: Networking in Practice
description: Campus networks, redundancy, capacity planning, and standards.
objectives: Relate physical links, switching, and routing to campus network operations.
Evaluate redundancy against shared causes of failure.
Size capacity for operation after a link fails.
